item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Sat Aug 1, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: Dear Soldier Boy - Bird-in-Hand Stage — Tue Aug 4 — Bird-in-Hand Stage
item.description:
An Old-Fashioned, Light-Hearted Whodunit A small Pennsylvania town is shaken when Zack Fisher, the infant son of a prominent Amish family, is kidnapped. Accusations fly. Although everyone comes under suspicion, the case goes cold. Zack’s sister Naomi, who was supposed to be watching him, blames herself for the next 20 years – then takes matters into her own hands. Packed with a cast of interesting and complex characters, including a quirky, noir-style detective and an amateur Amish sleuth, this musical mystery tells a moving story about learning to forgive yourself. If faith, family, and self-forgiveness matter to you, Stolen will steal your heart.
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.title: M-Uth Theatre Ensemble Presents Radium Girls & Antigone in Munich — Sat Aug 8, 2:00 PM — Ware Center for the Arts
item.description:
Join the M-Uth Theatre Ensemble for a weekend of powerful, free community theatre featuring two remarkable true stories of courage, truth, and resistance. Admission to all shows is free, and no tickets are required.
The M-Uth Theatre Ensemble is an inclusive, mixed-ability company for teens and young adults from all backgrounds—bringing together diverse young performers, including those who face or have faced significant life challenges, to broaden access to the arts.
Performance ScheduleOn Saturday, Aug. 8, at 2 p.m., the M-Uth Theatre Ensemble presents a reprise performance of Antigone in Munich by Claudia Hass, which first ran at the Ware Center in summer 2025. The show returns for one performance only, featuring the full cast from the original production. Antigone in Munich tells the true story of Sophie Scholl, a member of the White Rose student resistance group in Nazi Germany, as she comes of age and evolves from bystander to activist. item.title: LFS Monthly Discussion - El Serrano's — Wed Sep 2, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Lancaster Freethought Society Come joins us for intelligent discussion and freethinking fun at our monthly meeting. Lancaster Freethought Society is a community for Freethinkers, Atheists, Agnostics, Humanists, Non-believers, Skeptics, and those who are simply curious. There is no fee to attend our meetings which range from topical subjects of interest to freethinkers such as Church/State Separation, as well as subjects such as science, philosophy, ethics, counter-apologetics, and psychology. All are welcome to attend no matter what your beliefs may be but proselytizing is not allowed. Bring your articles, news, jokes, gripes, questions, ideas, topics, or anything else you would like to discuss with the rest of the group.
Hope to see you there!
Source: Meetup: Lancaster Freethought Society
